beats.en: With the digits 3 and 7 you can make 333, 337, 373, 377, 733, 737, 773 and 777. Digits can repeat. The smallest is 333 and the largest is 777.

textbookBox.concept: After 999 comes 1000. Gulnaz and Jaspreet keep a number chart and when the chart reaches 1000, the thousandth person has come for the langar. Ten hundreds make one thousand.

beats.en: Some things you count are small in number and some are very large. The number of children in your village is more than 1000, but the number of fingers on your hand is only 5.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 4 maths · Thousands Around Us · Complete Summary
textbookBox.concept: A 4-digit number has four places: Thousands (Th), Hundreds (H), Tens (T) and Ones (O). We read it starting from the thousands. The value of a digit depends on its place.

beats.en: Let us review the key takeaway from Thousands Around Us: A 4-digit number has four places: Thousands (Th), Hundreds (H), Tens (T) and Ones (O). We read it starting from the thousands. The value of a digit depends on its place.
